title: JiangHu
tagline: Where people gather, Jianghu emerges. A Cyber-Wuxia DeFi protocol where staking is Cultivation
description:
Welcome to JiangHu (The River and Lakes) — the first "Cyber-Wuxia" gamified DeFi protocol on Ethereum.

DeFi is often cold and solitary. We reimagine the blockchain as a mystical realm of martial arts. In JiangHu, Liquidity is "Internal Energy" (Qi), and Staking is "Cultivation" (Xiulian).

Core Gameplay & DeFi Mechanics:

Cultivation (Staking): Users deposit assets into "Spirit Gathering Arrays" (Vaults) to accumulate Qi (ERC-20 Yield Tokens). The longer you stake, the higher your Realm (Tier).

Sects (DAO Pools): Users can join different Sects (Staking Pools). Each Sect competes for "Heavenly Treasures" (Yield Boosts/NFTs) that increase the APY for all members.

The "Bridal Clothes Skill" (Yield Redirection): This is our killer feature for social onboarding. In Wuxia lore, a master can transfer their lifetime of cultivation to a disciple. In JiangHu, a veteran staker can use this function to redirect their real-time yield to a new wallet. This solves the "cold start" problem for new users (disciples), giving them immediate gas and assets to start their journey.

We are not just building a staking protocol; we are building a reputation-based society where "Grandmasters" (Whales) are incentivized to help "Disciples" (Newcomers) in exchange for Soulbound Tokens (SBT) and on-chain prestige.
how_its_made:
JiangHu is built as a hybrid of a sophisticated DeFi vault and an on-chain RPG.

1. The Smart Contracts (The Law of Heaven): We developed the core logic using Solidity. The central innovation is the CultivationVault contract, which is a modified staking implementation. Unlike standard MasterChef contracts, we separated the beneficiary from the staker. The transferYield(address _disciple) function allows the "Bridal Clothes Skill" to redirect pending rewards without unstaking the principal assets. We deployed these contracts on Base to ensure low gas fees for high-frequency interactions.

2. AI Agent as the "Dungeon Master" (The Heavenly Dao): We integrated an AI Agent (using LLMs) to act as the storyteller. When a user connects their wallet, the Agent analyzes their on-chain history to assign them a "Root Bone" (Initial Attributes). For example, a user with high degen activity gets the "Fire Spirit Root". The Agent also generates unique, flavor-text logs for every transaction (e.g., "You withstood the Tribulation of Volatility and broke through to the Gold Core Realm"), making the UX immersive.

3. Frontend & Visuals (The Aesthetics): The frontend is built with Next.js and RainbowKit. We eschewed standard corporate Memphis design for a Y2K Cyber-Wuxia aesthetic—blending traditional Chinese talismans with glitch art and neon visuals to create a unique "JiangHu" vibe.
